43244990.text: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
43244990.title: A Clue to Sander's Treasure

fd53ac89.text:
Master Longbeard,

As you know, we Stormpikes have an eye for excellence, and so the quality of your shields is no mystery to us.

I, therefore, am keen to commission you for such a shield.  I have included specifications on the following page:
fd53ac89.title: Stormpike's Request

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11042|aa055e90.name: Sylvanna Forestmoon
11042|aa055e90.text: My skill at creating potions is inferior to yours. You are ready to speak with Ainethil, just over there. She will understand that you are ready for further instruction.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

12042|e653c173.name: Loganaar
12042|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1275|fe52f4ea.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1292|aebd25b1.name: Maris Granger
1292|aebd25b1.text: Do I look like I have the time or energy to coddle every tourist that wanders through my door? Tell me what you need, and make it quick.

1300|d1216699.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|d1216699.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

1313|0624ab70.name: Maria Lumere
1313|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1313|23d8b931.name: Maria Lumere
1313|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1319|877c4b1d.name: Bryan Cross
1319|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1341|877c4b1d.name: Wilhelm Strang
1341|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1346|77289fa3.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|77289fa3.text: Yes, I've been running this shop for some time now. Business has been pretty good lately. A lot of new adventurers coming through...

1430|52392408.name: Tomas
1430|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1683|279d82d3.name: Warg Deepwater
1683|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

2057|b0e063a7.name: Huldar
2057|b0e063a7.text:
This is a dangerous line of business!

Miran just left with a delivery. He should be back in a few minutes.

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|6928abbf.name: Newton Burnside
2456|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

249713|0c768ee1.name: Odd Child
249713|0c768ee1.text: Shhh! You'll give away my hiding spot!

251507|5a99763b.name: Josephine Carson
251507|5a99763b.text: Sorry, you don't look like you could fully draw a longbow, nor load a musket. I teach real hunters.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

258930|4ef1d72e.name: Isaac Chan
258930|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

4160|a52edd3e.name: Ainethil
4160|a52edd3e.text: Your education is progressing well. You should be proud of your accomplishments.

4210|52392408.name: Alegorn
4210|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

4211|33af2c00.name: Dannelor
4211|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|34f0a84a.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5499|3fbbaef8.name: Lilyssia Nightbreeze
5499|3fbbaef8.text: You are beyond my limited abilities. Seek out the $r Ainethil in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. She can teach you more. I only wish that I could go with you.

5500|e64e6f5e.name: Tel'Athir
5500|e64e6f5e.text: You must choose a more experienced teacher, for you have surpassed my abilities. I advise you to speak with Lilyssia Nightbreeze here: she has much knowledge to offer.

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5504|e653c173.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5505|e653c173.name: Theridran
5505|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5518|6f4cdd8b.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|6f4cdd8b.text: Let's see... fourteen plus seven, carry the two... oh, yes?

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

913|2fd50a65.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|2fd50a65.text:
I can tell just by the way you're standing that you're no warrior.  

Why don't you go do something safe, like read a book.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

92109-accept.name: Odd Child
92109-accept.text:
Erm... 'Ello, miss. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109-accept.title: My First Alchemy Set

92109-complete.name: Odd Child
92109-complete.text:
Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?

Wow, thanks miss, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?
92109-complete.title: My First Alchemy Set

92109-progress.name: Odd Child
92109-progress.text: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
92109-progress.title: My First Alchemy Set

92110-accept.name: Odd Child
92110-accept.text:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110-accept.title: My First Real Potion

92110-complete.name: Odd Child
92110-complete.text:
You brought me murloc eyes! I am so, so excited for my first REAL potion!

I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.

<The child watches enthusiastically as you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>

Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
92110-complete.title: My First Real Potion

92110-progress.name: Odd Child
92110-progress.text: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
92110-progress.title: My First Real Potion

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92751-progress.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-progress.text: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
92751-progress.title: Detonation at a Distance

92909-progress.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-progress.text: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909-progress.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
